_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Polychlorinated Biphenyl (PCB) Inventory Report
summary: This DID specifies the format and content for a report inventorying items containing PCBs, used to control eventual disposal of PCB-containing equipment.
use_relationship:
This DID contains detailed information about specific items containing PCBs. It is used for the control of eventual disposal of equipment containing PCBs.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the discrete task requirement as specified in 40 CFR 761 delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revision, shall be specified in contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content:
The report shall contain all of the information specified in standard 40 CFR 761 and shall also include the following:
Installation name
EPA identification number
Office and phone number of the person preparing the inventory
Date prepared using the following format: yy/mm/dd

The report shall include In-service PCB items identifying the following:
Serial/Id # - The identification or serial number found on the PCB containing item.
Ship/Compartment No. - Location of the PCB containing item.
PPM/Date - The amount of PCB contained in the PCB items and PCB contaminated items as tested, expressed in parts per million (ppm). If the item is sealed or has not been tested, the information be specified on the label.

The Report shall include the date the analysis was performed, if applicable and shall identify the following:
Equipment Type - Type of system and equipment PCB items is in.
Manufacturer - Information from equipment label, if available.
